findings.source_quote: They fell, down, down. Down they came and landed with a quiet splash on the little heap of trash.
findings.suggested_fix: Yalitiririka chini, chini. Yalianguka na kutua kwa mlio hafifu wa kitu kilichodondoka kwenye kichuguu hicho kidogo cha takataka.
findings.translation_quote: Yalitiririka chini, chini. Yalianguka na kutua kwa kishindo hafifu juu ya kichuguu hicho kidogo cha takataka.
